body.cap: Overview of DNX's elderly care solution | Provided by DNX

body.x: DNX Co., Ltd., CEO Eun-kyeong Kwon, participated in ‘CES 2023’, held in Las Vegas, USA for 4 days between January 5th (Thurs) and 8th (Sun, local time).

DNX, established in 2015, is a company that has developed services to improve the quality of life of the elderly population based on its monitoring technology, behavioral science, and data analysis and prediction capabilities. To do this, DNX is collaborating with experts in fields such as medical and psychological care, computer science, artificial intelligence, and telecommunications technology. DNX has successfully developed an in-human communication chip that utilizes the body as a transmission medium and holds related patents.

In particular, the company states that it is continuously making efforts to expand the service coverage by distributing the elderly care service nationwide to local governments and households in Korea. In addition, the company has recently started providing services in Japan, demonstrating its expanding influence in the global market.

At CES 2023, DNX introduced a service that combines its flagship product, touch tag, with situation-aware AI to improve the overall quality of life for the elderly. Touch tag is a product that can be installed on indoor interior accessories such as furniture and appliances, and automatically collects user behavior data within the range recognized by each sensor. It has the advantage of being able to provide high data accuracy without disrupting the user's daily life due to its small size.

The mobile application (app) that can be linked to the touch tags analyzes the user's behavior patterns through the collected behavior data and situation-aware AI, and aims to help the user's healthy living and overcome depression through proactive intervention. In addition, it provides the results of the data analysis to the guardian remotely, and allows the guardian to understand the user's situation and activity status, location, etc.

A DNX representative said, 'Our services and products started from ideas for serving the socially vulnerable, and now have gained great interest as solutions that can mitigate or address the rapid aging that threatens the world today.' They added,, 'The greatest value is that we can simultaneously provide effective life management for the elderly population and assuage the worries of guardians who find it difficult to visit them every time.'

In addition, the representative said, 'At this CES, we plan to actively seek out new investors, buyers, and collaboration partners to promote these products and services more widely.' They also stated, 'We will strive to enter markets in various countries to solve the problem of aging throughout the world, starting with Korea and Japan where our services are currently available.'

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.
